16-31.solution: After 2 years: \(18000 \times 1.1^2 = 21780\). The last half year earns simple interest on that: \(21780 \times 0.10 \times 0.5 = 1089\), so the amount is \(22869\) and the interest is \(22869 - 18000 = 4869\).

16-51.solution: Quarterly at \(2.5\%\) for 12 quarters: \(\frac{100000}{1.025^{12}} = \frac{100000}{1.344889} \approx 74355.59\), which is Rs. \(74400\) to the nearest hundred.
